advancements.breathless.perseverance.des: Get a Stagnated builder to tower up to you. No matter what may come, I will keep pushing.
advancements.breathless.my_mind_of_many_: Lure a Stagnated with a sculk sensor. It heard something. It always hears something.
advancements.breathless.hate_filled_amal: See a Warden kill a Stagnated. It can no longer tell friend from foe due to its rage.
Watch a Stagnated kill a zombie or skeleton. Not its own.
advancements.breathless.finally_still.de: Kill 10 Stagnated. Ten who can rest now.
advancements.breathless.for_those_who_fi: Read a researcher's last words. He hoped someone would.
breathless.lore.mandel.title: Researcher Mandel's Report
breathless.lore.mandel.body:
Contact with the soul dimension, or the "Sift", has been made, though with much effort.
Although the time to observe and take samples was brief, it was concluded that the life within the dimension is very diverse and healthy, the soil made up of souls, and the sky a brilliant teal.
However, to our great dismay, taking the soil from its environment proved consequential, as the soil rotted and decayed at a very fast rate and spread from where it leaked through the portal.
We have contained the biohazard and designated it with the name 5-L0 (5-L0TH). The biohazard proved to be sentient, as many of those subjected to contact with the specimen during the incident have reported that it "spoke" to them.
However, the specimen proved to be territorial. It will suffocate any living being that invades any containment cell, which it also has a habit of attempting to break out of to widen its territory.
Security will be issued iron kits as a precaution.
Included are the blueprints for the reinforced filters, for up close interactions with the specimen.
Please distribute them to the lower class researchers.
- Mandel
breathless.lore.mcnally.title: McNally's Complaint
breathless.lore.mcnally.body:
Now, Nally. I understand why you said what you said in the complaint letter, but you definitely could have said it better than you did.
Excavating and building for us has been really helpful, and of course we value you and your men dearly. We understand the caves can get dark and it leaves you and your men vulnerable and, more importantly, unable to do your work.
So here are the blueprints for the NV-1 masks. They use local resources found from glow squids, so they shouldn't be too hard to produce.
And as always, we appreciate what you do for us and look forward to more progress.
- Yours Truly, Management.
breathless.lore.howard.title: UrG3Nt M4Il!!11
breathless.lore.howard.body:
Hey, Mandel. I know it's late, but did you receive my previous email about the new specimen? Not the weird "sculk" thing but the biological digital <k>[REDACTED]</k> thing?
It's really weird. Some of the men die from internal burns, if that's even possible, after taking too many of those adrenaline shots to keep them working. Some who take about three or four say they see "pop ups" on their screen telling them to shoot up more, so four is the limit. <r>[RENDERING ERROR] error code: 404</r>
I think they take that many to numb the pain. Maybe we should start lowering their hours..?
There's something beyond us we can't even comprehend, so since you're top researcher, why don't you get on that case? Make it a specimen and designate it a name. F-13, because it sounds like a racing car and because once it's complete it's called <k>[F13ND]</k>. Creative, eh? Just like 5-L0TH.
Anyways, management wants the shots reworked, so no promises there. In the meantime the medics have been brewing a stronger batch of that honey tonic to take the edge off. It's gentler than the shots and the men actually like the taste. Here's the recipe, pass it along.
- Your Very Awesome Friend, Howard.
breathless.lore.vincent.title: To Whoever Finds This.
breathless.lore.vincent.body:
My name is Vincent Granger, a researcher at <k>[REDACTED]</k>, and these are my last words.
I wish I had lived a fuller and more joyous life than wasting away here, watching people die and their bodies being used as puppets.
We shouldn't have opened that damn portal. Everything went wrong from messing with things we don't understand.
You just had to keep the portal open for so long, and now here we are.
I have exhausted my options and I can hear it beckoning me out of hiding, but I will not grant it the pleasure of killing me.
I will immolate myself and free myself of my stress and worries.
I will go to hell, but I sure as hell hope I see you there, Mandel.
Damn you and your project.
